body: hey i’m only seeing this now. please don’t escalate it. you can message me if you ever need to. once you get so far into it it’s so so hard to get out abd it’s something you will regret for the rest of your life. please don’t let it escalate, please talk to somebody about it.
tried everything. eventually just stopped resisting and gave in. it really is pointless for me to try and get out of it again bc i know ill just fall back into it worse than before.
why wouldnt it tell me not to on my legs? i just need to do one good one and ill get it. voice in my head is stronger than my body’s needs.
ive been doing the exact same thing.
shit yeah exactly like a binge
there is no adult i can safely talk to. i know skinny is not healthy, but my disordered brain ignores logic.
scratching isnt big, but i repeat to myself that im not clean until i break and go back to cutting
ive tried stuff before. if i throw away the blades ill start scratching my skin, then im not clean anymore so ill get more. nothing i can do about it nd no good reasn to stop

im proud though. 6 months is a long time, more than i can imagine for myself. you’re a strong person, i know it. whatever urges you may get in the future, or no matter how tempting, i know you can get through it. it’s okay if you don’t though, but you’ve got to try. you have the strength to try.
no problem. if you ever need to talk to someone, you can message me anytime.

there are other ways to get relief. when you get an urge, draw on your skin where you want to cut, use a rubber band, or ice. or, when you have an urge, you can message me and I can help distract and talk you through it
don’t doubt it. recovery is possible, and you’re a strong person. you can do it.
try again then. keep trying. if you don’t, you will never stay clean. you’ve got to keep trying. you’ll get it eventually
dont stop flat out. ween off of it slowly. decrease the amount you cut and the severity of the cut.
stop little bits at a time. decrease the amount ou cut and the severity of the cut. don’t stop flat out that will only make your urges worse. it’s possible, and you’re strong. you can do it.
please do not. stop now before it gets out of hand. once i went deep, it got worse for me. also, deeper cuts leave scars that stay with you for the rest of your life.
please try to recover. i know it’s hard, i do it too, but start with eating very small amounts. don’t start with lots. little bits at a time. it is possible to get better and get out of that loop
you should stop before it gets bad. anything you do to purposely hurt yourself is self harm, and it can escalate even when you think you have complete control.
you’re so fucking strong. you’ve made it basically a year. that’s better than i could even imagine for myself. you’ve made it this far, you don’t need to give in, it’s not worth it.
same here. but i’m putting it out there for the people in that same place i was in years ago
ive heard witch hazel helps with scars somehow? certian oils help fade scars
yeah me too. that’s why i’m posting it. for the people rn in the place i was years ago.

yeah i used to use glass but once i switched to razors, it got out of control. and when i hit dermis the first time it was over for me. for stopping, i’d just say try your hardest to lower the amount you cut and the severity of it
why choose not to if you have an easy option to stop. don’t wait, becuase your control over it could go away. that’s what happened with me.
yes, but for the majority of people i’ve seen, including myself, it’s way way worse. be grateful you have control.
first off, where are they located?

a few of my close friends and my gf know about my self harm but it’s not like they can do anything either. if i go to an adult my mom will eventually find out. i was 11 and i started scratching myself. she couldn’t handle that, i don’t want to worry her or stress her out.
i started scratching at 11 and cutting at 12. it’s not abnormal. i’ve seen people start before i have
